**Resubmitted: T4C — deviation (high), preferred level.**

Repairs made in response to the verifier:

1. **Customer convenience termination presence** — the new Section 11.4 now expressly identifies Corio as "Commerce One's customer under this Agreement" when granting the convenience right, so the right reads on its face as a Customer convenience termination. I used lowercase "customer" deliberately: Section 1.6 defines "CUSTOMER(S)" as Corio's *own* sublicensees, so capitalising would have created a defined-term conflict.
2. **Section numbering nit** — "11.4" is now embedded in the inserted paragraph text (the numbering field did not render), keeping Section 11.3's survival list and any future cross-references clean.
3. **Ceiling respected** — I did not add the optional "for the avoidance of doubt" non-renewal carve-out, since it is not a checklist element; Sections 11.1–11.3 remain verbatim, including the Customer-favourable survival and support-continuation rights.

All four preferred elements remain carried by the single insertion: Corio convenience right, 30 days' written notice, pro rata refund of prepaid fees, and an express bar on Commerce One convenience termination during the initial five-year and renewal terms.
